simple.summary: שָׂחַט (sâchaṭ) means to tread out , i.e. squeeze (grapes) First listed occurrence: Gen 40 11.

definitions.full: H7818. sachat [ שָׂחַט ] verb squeeze out (so Late Hebrew סָחַט , Aramaic סְחַט ; Mandean סהט spread out Nö M 238 ); — Qal Imperfect 1singular וָאֶשְׂחַט Gen 40:11 (E; אֶל אֶתהָֿעֲנָבִים ).
